description: All counters and thresholds for the vocabulary-control harness. Thresholds were derived from a 141k-word reference corpus of published ML papers, not from vibes. Tune per project, never per section.

_notes.flesch_main_min/max: Readability band for main text: below 18 is unreadable, above 55 is dumbed down.
_notes.metaphor_max_per_section: The neuroslop killer: at most one metaphor/colloquialism per section.
_notes.terminology_names_max: One concept, at most two distinct names in the whole text.
_notes.words_per_number_min: At least 25 prose words between two numbers, or the text reads like a spreadsheet.
